title: 13 Whether the last iudgement bee to be wiſhed for.

segments.text: WE are doubtleſſe to wiſh for the day of iudgement, becauſe it is an vndoubted ſigne and token of that difference, whereby the Elect are diſcerned from the reprobate: which declaration the Godly doe earneſtly deſire. Moreouer it ſhall bee a deliuerie out of thoſe miſeries in which we are. Rom. 7.24. O wretched man that I am, who ſhall deliuer me from the bodie of this death? Reu. 22.17. The ſpirit & the Bride ſay, Come Lord Jeſu: which they ſay not, who are not ready to receiue the Lorde. For the wicked tremble and ſhake at the mention of that iudgement.
